modelingNotes: Identity: radical LC1D32 (3-pole, AC-3 32 A, screw-clamp) + DC coil code BD. Manufacturer spelling is LC1D32BD; the job/source hyphen 'LC1-D32BD' is a presentation separator, not a distinct catalog number. No successor substituted.

Coil code BD = 24 V DC, verified in the B8/8 and B8/10 DC-supply tables (Volts 12/24/36... <-> JD/BD/CD... for LC1D09...D38). Operate range U 0.7...1.25 Uc (~16.8-30 V). LC1D09...D32 DC coils include an integral suppression device by bi-directional peak-limiting diode, but the manufacturer specifies A1 positive and A2 negative (FAQ FA121938); the suppressor is not a fixed net join.

Auxiliary configuration 1 NO + 1 NC is a built-in (instantaneous) contact per the B8/8 selection row (columns '1 1'). Verified terminal marks from scheme 127266.eps (B8/79, LC1D09-D150): NO 13-14, NC 21-22.

Main poles are three NO power contacts, marks 1/L1-2/T1, 3/L2-4/T2, 5/L3-6/T3 (visually inspected on scheme 127266.eps). Terminal keys use the primary IEC numbers 1..6; the L/T power marks are in the descriptions.

Ratings are capabilities, not flattened scalars: main poles 32 A AC-3 (15 kW/400 V, <=440 V), AC-1 50 A at <=60 C, insulation family up to 690 V. Only the coil carries an assigned terminal rating (24 V DC), which is this device's fixed control supply. Aux 13-14/21-22 AC-15/DC-13 capabilities kept in research notes.

Contacts and coil are switched/mechanical, not permanent nets: no fixed internal links are asserted. The coil actuates all three poles and both auxiliary contacts (mechanical linkage, dashed on the scheme).

Screw-clamp version assumed from the reference radical LC1D32 (spring version = LC1D323, lug version inserts a 6); the source order shows neither insert. A duplicated coil terminal, seen on some TeSys D bodies, is not shown on the family scheme and is not modeled.

Manufacturer FAQ FA121938 explicitly specifies A1 positive and A2 negative for LC1D***D DC coils. A bidirectional suppressor does not justify the original inference that coil polarity is arbitrary. https://www.se.com/us/en/faqs/FA121938/

connectionCoverage.notes: All12 labeled circuit endpoints are represented. Physical duplicate-access/clamping positions and any accessory suppression attachment geometry are not separately enumerated for the historical hardware edition; connection coverage is partial for those details. No extra terminal or fixed link is inferred. Optional external accessories remain separate.
